raw.title: CannaMed Cannabis Capsules 100mg (10 Capsules)
raw.description: Convenient and Discreet - No need to smoke or vape; take the capsule with water for an easy experience

regression_note: THE canonical false-positive case that motivated the entire facet refactor (01-ARCHITECTURE.md §4, ADR-002). 'No need to smoke or vape' must not make a capsule vapeable/smokable. Fixed by stripping negation windows (negation_strip_pattern in categories.json) BEFORE any form-word matching runs, not by filtering matches after the fact.
